## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete user problem and what changes. State current scope and remaining limits.

## Validation

Report commands actually run and their results. Separate protocol fixtures from real model/runtime evidence; do not claim an optimization gain without a valid comparison.

## Delivery notes

Mention affected English/Chinese UI or docs, dependencies/license duties and runtime requirements. Exclude keys, .sts state, actual user data and private development records.
